fixer.title: Avoid reading large agent host files when opening Changes

introducer.title: Fix multi-diff and native host event leaks

cases.mechanism: The old multi-diff mapper eagerly created a text-model reference for every side. AgentHostFileSystemProvider only exposes whole-file FileReadWrite, so its readFile issues resourceRead for the complete file, whose server implementation reads the full file and returns it base64-encoded; binary detection and size validation therefore occurred only after transferring and allocating the whole payload.
cases.symptom: Opening Changes with an oversized Agent Host file could transfer, base64 encode/decode, and allocate the entire remote file before showing it as binary, causing long open latency and high memory/GC pressure (the added regression test models a 150 MB file).
cases.fixedBehavior: The new preflight size check classifies oversized resources and the condition on line 271 skips createModelReference for both sides, avoiding the whole-file resourceRead and showing a placeholder instead.
cases.evidence: Base line 225 created a model reference unconditionally for every defined URI. The traced provider path is createModelReference -> TextFileService.readStream -> FileService.readFileStream -> AgentHostFileSystemProvider.readFile -> resourceRead; FileSystemResources.read uses IFileService.readFile and returns the complete encoded payload. Added tests assert that a 150 MB Agent Host resource is not loaded, while an 80-byte resource still is.
